title: Beyond the LC25000 ceiling: optimizer robustness and external validity of a convolutional network and a vision transformer for lung cancer histopathology classification
description: Official replication package containing training and evaluation code, split manifests, configuration files, per-epoch logs, per-fold metrics, and publication figure scripts for comparative benchmarking of ResNet50 and ViT-S/16 on LC25000 and LungHist700 histopathology datasets.
